name: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
summary: Keeper Albagorm seeks help for the Charred Vale from far to the south. The Bloodfury harpies have been driven back for now, but the wounded land needs more than force to heal.

sections.title: The Scars of the Vale
sections.body: The Charred Vale lies beneath ash in southern Stonetalon Mountains, scarred by terrible destruction. Alliance forces under Keeper Albagorm have driven the Bloodfury harpies from their nests in the ruins, but their retreat may not last. Albagorm knows that force can only hold the harpies back. The ravaged earth must be healed before they return and take the Vale again.

sections.title: A Plea to the South
sections.body: The grove tenders need help beyond their own means to restore the scorched land. Albagorm sends you south, past the salt flats and canyons of Thousand Needles, to Thalanaar on the border of Feralas. Falfindel Waywarder waits there. The night elf druid is known for a rare gift: calling on ancient forest spirits to bring life back to dead soil.

faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm is a keeper of the grove at Stonetalon Peak. He oversees Alliance efforts to cleanse and restore the blighted Charred Vale.
Falfindel Waywarder is at Thalanaar, on the western border where Thousand Needles meets Feralas.

faq.q: Why send for a druid all the way in Feralas?
faq.answer: Keeper Albagorm believes Falfindel can summon ancient forest spirits powerful enough to heal the deep damage in the Charred Vale.

faq.q: What threat resides in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: Hostile Bloodfury harpies, fire elementals, and wild beasts live in the valley, thriving in the wake of its burning.
No combat is required. You carry Albagorm's message across central and southern Kalimdor.

faq.q: How do you reach Thousand Needles from Stonetalon?
aliases: how to get to thousand needles
faq.answer: From Stonetalon Mountains, travel east into the Barrens, then south along the Gold Road. Take the Great Lift down into Thousand Needles and continue west toward Feralas.

angles.text: As a druid, you share the Cenarion duty to reach beyond local garrisons and call on primal nature spirits to heal lands scarred by unnatural ruin.
As an Alliance member, you rely on Stonetalon Peak's foothold and the links between frontier outposts across Kalimdor's vast, contested reaches.
